summary: Kima Ventures, the investment vehicle associated with Xavier Niel, calls itself the most active business angel in the world and says it backs two startups a week. Its homepage states the Kima deal: one-off tickets of $150,000 in about 100 new deals a year, at any stage, deal size and sector. The site lists recent investments and links portfolio companies including Alan and Mistral. Geography, an application route and a street address are not stated on the homepage.

investmentEvidence.fact: Listed on the homepage as a recent investment (AI responses automation). The date is not stated.
Linked from the homepage as a portfolio company. Round and date are not stated.

sources.title: Homepage: ticket size, deal volume, any stage and sector, recent investments and portfolio links
